card.name: Inside benzodiazepine names and dose ranges
card.fires_on: Partway through benzodiazepine names such as estazolam, clobazam and lorazepam, and on the space or 'and' just before a dose number or drug name in benzodiazepine labels.

modes.label: Benzodiazepine names
modes.description: Fires on the middle or end of a benzodiazepine name like estazolam, clobazam or lorazepam.

modes.label: Spacing in dose schedules
modes.description: Fires on a space between numbers in dose schedules, like '3 or 4 times daily' or 'Day 3'.

card.plain: It fires inside benzodiazepine drug names and on gaps in dosing schedules in their labels.
